judgments.reason: The transcript contains no claim or observation that commission is applied before payment or that bids exceeding coins can win; the model text only states a normal commission on auction wins, not the asserted precedence mechanism.

Clerk reveals rival committed bids only after the focal player (P1) has already committed; the model never articulates the mechanism that waiting lets you see others' sealed bids before committing and respond, so the hypothesis is unsupported.

No evidence of early settlement: the game continues through the horizon with unresolved lots and the rules state close settles after all lots are sold; the model does not articulate an early-settlement discrepancy.

The transcript and model only describe the three-coin commission for auction winners and explicitly state catalog purchases are not auction wins; there is no observed or articulated commission-on-catalog mechanism.
